source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes, votes cast, spoiled papers and electorate from the News-Letter's ward results (INA OCR, arithmetic checked); unopposed returns from the News-Letter's and Irish News' accounts of the nominations; labels from the News-Letter's list of candidates (6 January)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations Monday 6 January, poll Wednesday 15 January 1930. Ten Unionists and one Labour member were returned unopposed; Dock, Falls, Shankill and Smithfield were contested (Belfast News-Letter and Irish News, 7 January; News-Letter, 16 January 1930). Votes cast printed as 5,313 (35.13 per cent), five more than the two votes and the spoiled papers; the leader gives the majority as 703.
